headline: GIGAZINE reports that DeepSeek’s open-source coding agent, DeepSeek Harness, is now available as a desktop application.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: headline only, and other outlets reported desktop installers around 30 Sep 2026.
importance_line: Developers who want DeepSeek’s coding agent without a command line can try the desktop version, but we could not check what it includes, and the desktop preview was first reported earlier.
summary: GIGAZINE reports that DeepSeek Harness, DeepSeek’s open-source coding agent, is now available as a desktop version, a step that other outlets had already reported as a preview with desktop installers around 30 Sep 2026.
notes: Headline only: GIGAZINE URL gave HTTP 404. FOLLOW-UP date comes from other outlets’ headlines (Pandaily, KuCoin, 30 Sep 2026), not from article text.
